summaryZh: Kryazhimskiy 实验室研究突变如何在多层次影响表型，并共同决定不同环境中的适合度。研究结合酿酒酵母和大肠杆菌实验与数学建模，考察遗传背景、环境、上位性及多效性。
researchQuestions: 突变如何影响基因表达、代谢通量等不同层次的表型，这些影响又如何共同决定生物在不同环境中的适合度？

evidence.quote: We approach this problem using experiments in model microorganisms S. cerevisiae and E.coli and mathematical modeling. Our lab has three complementary themes.

how mutations affect phenotypes at multiple levels of biological organization (gene expression, metabolic fluxes, etc.), and how these effects combine to determine organism’s fitness across environments.
we characterize the statistics of epistasis and pleiotropy.
